by
  -- Step 1: Show that t * X is AEMeasurable
  have h_mul : AEMeasurable (fun ω => t * X ω) μ := AEMeasurable.mul_const hX t
  -- Step 2: Use AEMeasurable.exp to get AEMeasurable of exp(t * X)
  have h_exp : AEMeasurable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ := AEMeasurable.exp h_mul
  -- Step 3: Show that t * X is AEStronglyMeasurable
  have h_strong_mul : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => t * X ω) μ := AEStronglyMeasurable.mul_const hX t
  -- Step 4: Use AEStronglyMeasurable.exp to get AEStronglyMeasurable of exp(t * X)
  exact AEStronglyMeasurable.exp h_strong_mul
